mode: pairs sequential; arms started in alternating A/B order with overlapping execution on identical dedicated GPU slots
subsequent_pairs: alternate which arm starts first and uses slot1; other arm uses slot2
resources: identical NVIDIA RTX4090; OMP/BLAS1 per process; no other GPU workload at resume
reason: count every automatic review/scheduling second; do not exclude one prepared arm waiting for the other as human review
inference: independent fresh responses, identical model/config; no shared answers
comparison_limitation: paired concurrent OS/service contention is part of this fixed evaluation setting; component IO result remains separate
